bed_access: READ-ONLY (mode=ro URI); no index created; no pipeline run

latency_ms.note: Within a needle all three arms share the same page cache, so the paired delta understates a cold-cache cost. The arm-order split makes the direction of that bias visible: in ABC the LIMIT-50 arm pays the cold read, in CBA it runs warm.

interpretation: Tail production may reuse the shipped shortlist query with a widened LIMIT (design K1): head = rows[:50] is byte-identical to the shipped shortlist on every target measured. The knob-0 SQL string must still be pinned byte-identical by a test, and the ladder should carry shortlist_sha256 per needle so a regression is caught by the head-identity witness rather than assumed absent.
scope_limits: 216 ARM-1 targets (156 misses + 60 stratified hit controls), not all 470 needles: the capture only holds terms for those.
One bed (ERB 947k v09x, tagger v1). Says nothing about EnronQA, MULocBench, LoCoMo or FinanceBench.

SQLite 3.50.4 on this build only; FTS5's tie order is an implementation detail, not a documented contract, so a future SQLite upgrade re-opens the question. The per-needle shortlist_sha256 in the ladder is what keeps it honest.
Measures the SQL only. It does not measure the chromatin/party validation the tail would additionally pay, nor any scorer.
